items.name: Invite people and set their roles
items.reason: Invite the Operations/Care Lead, Finance Reviewer, Product maintainer and Fleet specialist as members, the stakeholder as viewer, in Members. Give the trusted technical admin org_admin in Keycloak.

items.name: Turn on two-step sign-in for everyone
items.reason: Two-step sign-in is enforced by the sign-in provider (Keycloak), not by this plan.

items.name: Turn on the two-person rule
items.reason: Approval policy > Two-person rule, once a second owner exists.

items.name: Connect integrations in the plan's order
items.reason: Model gateway, SMTP and phone push, one mailbox per business, calendar, WhatsApp, commerce, Zoom or Teams, tyre planning, speech, web search, marketing and social, webhooks. Each needs your own account and credentials.

items.name: Upload the knowledge documents
items.reason: Upload each business's documents into the knowledge folders with owner, version, approval status, effective date and review date in the title or a note.

items.name: Add webhook triggers to the store, CRM and issue tracker automations
items.reason: Automations 8, 9, 10, 16 and 24 need a webhook trigger from the source system. Create it in Automations > Triggers; its secret is shown once.

items.name: Test and turn on each automation
items.reason: Every automation is created turned off. Run it by hand, check the result, then turn on its schedule or trigger.

items.name: Choose routine WhatsApp templates
items.reason: WhatsApp > Templates > Send without asking, after testing each template.

items.name: Promote agents one action at a time
items.reason: Agents start at the plan's starting autonomy. Raise an agent's autonomy in its Settings only after its drafts have been checked.

items.name: Per-agent AI budget caps
items.reason: ANUM budgets AI use per workspace and per organization, not per agent. The plan's agent caps are added up into the workspace's monthly budget.

items.name: Budget alerts at 50, 75 and 90 percent
items.reason: ANUM records crossings at 80 and 100 percent only; at 100 percent it blocks, as the plan asks.

items.name: Approvals routed by AED amount or to non-owner roles
items.reason: Approval rules match tools, not amounts, and only owners decide approvals.

items.name: Banking, bank reconciliation and money movement
items.reason: No bank connection or payment tool exists; COD reconciliation uses commerce order data only.

items.name: Courier tracking and delivery proof
items.reason: No courier integration exists; delivery status comes from the commerce connector only.

items.name: Contact opt-out list
items.reason: Opt-outs are not recorded automatically.

items.name: Departments as objects
items.reason: A department is a name on agents and assistants; there is no department entity with its own members or policies.

items.name: Automations that run as a chosen agent
items.reason: An automation's task runs as the person who owns the schedule; the prompt carries the agent's duty, not its tools or autonomy.

items.name: Agents placed in each business workspace
items.reason: The plan is applied to the workspace you open it in. The business workspaces are created empty; open one and apply the plan there if it needs its own agents.

items.name: Configurable Home priorities
items.reason: Home shows Today's Focus, approvals and activity from the real modules in a fixed order; it never shows zero for missing data.

items.name: Loop limit of 5 cycles and retry counts per agent
items.reason: Run limits are fixed by the runtime, not configurable per agent.

approval_thresholds.label: Internal reports and tasks
approval_thresholds.anum: Read and internal-change tools run without approval where the agent's autonomy allows.

approval_thresholds.label: Routine support replies
approval_thresholds.anum: WhatsApp templates on the auto-send list send on their own; free text always asks.

approval_thresholds.label: Payments, transfers, purchases
approval_thresholds.plan: Human approval for any amount; a human executes
approval_thresholds.anum: ANUM has no payment tool, so money never moves from ANUM.

approval_thresholds.label: Refund up to AED 250
approval_thresholds.anum: Approvals cannot route by amount or to a non-owner role; every approval goes to workspace owners.

approval_thresholds.label: Refund above AED 250 or disputed
approval_thresholds.anum: Owners approve every gated action, but ANUM has no refund tool yet.

approval_thresholds.label: Goodwill discount up to AED 100 and 5%
approval_thresholds.anum: No discount tool exists.

approval_thresholds.label: Standard quote up to AED 5,000
approval_thresholds.anum: Quotes are drafts; sending one is an email that the owner approves.

approval_thresholds.label: Quote above AED 5,000 or non-standard
approval_thresholds.anum: Sending any quote email needs the owner's approval.

approval_thresholds.label: Financial commitment above AED 5,000
approval_thresholds.anum: Two-person approval exists but cannot depend on the amount.

approval_thresholds.label: Contract or signature
approval_thresholds.anum: No signing tool exists, so only a person signs.

approval_thresholds.label: Publish or change prices
approval_thresholds.anum: Approval rules 'Prices and stock' and 'Publishing' require the owner.

approval_thresholds.label: Campaign or social publication
approval_thresholds.anum: Approval rule 'Publishing'.

approval_thresholds.label: New promotional outreach
approval_thresholds.anum: Free-text sends always ask; consent is checked by the Contact Eligibility skill, not enforced by ANUM.

approval_thresholds.label: Personal-data export or sharing
approval_thresholds.anum: Privacy export is per person; workspace audit export needs the owner.

approval_thresholds.label: Delete records
approval_thresholds.anum: Delete actions are protected: they always ask.

approval_thresholds.label: Access, policy or retention change
approval_thresholds.anum: Needs the owner or organization administrator role and is audited.

approval_thresholds.label: Approval expiry 24 hours
approval_thresholds.anum: ANUM's approval time-to-live is 24 hours by default.

approval_thresholds.label: Payload change invalidates approval
approval_thresholds.anum: Approvals are bound to the payload hash.

approval_thresholds.label: No self-approval
approval_thresholds.anum: Turn on the two-person rule in Approval policy (needs two owners).

approval_thresholds.label: Bulk = more than 10 promotional recipients in 24 hours
approval_thresholds.anum: ANUM asks for sends above 5 recipients by default, which is stricter.

approval_thresholds.label: Task estimated above AED 20
approval_thresholds.anum: ANUM has no per-task cost estimate before a run; the monthly budget stops calls instead.

memory_rules.label: Owner preferences
memory_rules.anum: One retention period (90 days) applies to remembered chat facts; ANUM has no per-category retention.

memory_rules.label: Brand tone
memory_rules.anum: Store it as a note in Knowledge base 01 Business Facts (notes are kept until deleted).

memory_rules.label: SOP references
memory_rules.anum: Notes and documents in Knowledge base 02 SOPs.

memory_rules.label: Lead context
memory_rules.anum: Remembered chat facts expire after 90 days.

memory_rules.label: Meeting decisions
memory_rules.anum: Meeting notes are drafts until a person confirms them.

memory_rules.label: Raw audio
memory_rules.anum: Voice retention is handled by the voice retention job.

memory_rules.label: Never: passwords, tokens, recovery codes, card details, unnecessary IDs, unrelated family or health data
memory_rules.anum: Secrets are redacted from approvals and audit records; agents are told never to store them.
